news.title: The Paradise Leads a Subdued Box Office Month in September 2026
news.summary: The Telugu film industry experienced a largely underwhelming box office month in September 2026, with most releases struggling to make an impact. news.title: Tollywood Producers Face Financial Hurdles as Streaming Platforms Slash Budgets
news.summary: The Telugu film industry is confronting a significant financial crunch as major OTT platforms scale back their digital acquisition budgets and offer lower amounts. This shift may force filmmakers to prioritize controlled budgets and theatrical revenue for financial recovery.
